cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: A Kinder Version
cards.instruction: Protect someone from the full truth by offering a carefully edited explanation that feels kinder than complete honesty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved the useful portion of the gallery's feedback. Your portrait may be happier in a more adventurous exhibition.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're showing a fridge full of teeth. May I hear what they actually said?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're authorized to hear that the face doesn't immediately reveal your intention.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's your face. They called you unrecognizable, didn't they?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I approve their suggestion that viewers need more acquaintance with the sitter. I'll attend in the same shirt. You may place me beside it until everyone catches up.

reason: Make A control access to softened feedback and authorize a concrete supportive remedy after B identifies A as the sitter.
